params.label: lede

params.name: steps

default.title: Menu builder
default.say: Every screen of {product} in one table: its name, its group, its icon and its place in the menu.

default.title: Find a screen
default.say: Type part of a name or group; typos still find it.

default.title: Move a screen
default.say: Drag the grip at the start of a row to move it up or down. Alt and the arrow keys move it too.

default.title: Name, group and icon
default.say: Type over a name or a group. A new group name starts a new group in the menu. Pick an icon from the list.

default.title: Draft or Live
default.say: A screen added later arrives as a Draft that only you see. Press it to put it Live; from then on Access Control decides who sees it.

default.title: Back to the original
default.say: The round arrow puts one screen back to the name, group and icon the portal gave it.

default.title: Save
default.say: Save the menu. The menu on the left and every person's menu follow at once.
